name: Find iPhone 16 Pro Max and open details
description: Verifies the primary product-discovery workflow finds a model from a short query and opens a full product card.
steps: Enter 16 pro max in the search field
Open Apple iPhone 16 Pro Max 256GB with Подробнее
Review the product photo, specifications and offers
expected: The iPhone 16 Pro Max result is shown with a product image and its detail view displays specifications and merchant offers.

name: Review project and how-it-works information
description: Verifies a reviewer can understand what CenaRadar is and how merchant data will be integrated.
steps: Open О проекте from the top navigation
Close it and open Как работает
expected: Both information dialogs clearly describe CenaRadar as a Latvian comparison service in beta and explain that live product feeds are connected only after partner approval.

name: Review partner, privacy and affiliate disclosures on mobile
description: Verifies compliance and partnership information is reachable on a phone-sized viewport.
steps: Open Partneriem or Партнёрам and close it
expected: Each information dialog is readable on mobile and states the launch-stage partner status, local browser storage behavior, and affiliate commission disclosure.

name: Persist favorites and price alerts
description: Verifies saved user preferences remain available after reload.
steps: Open its details and enable a price alert
Refresh the page and use the heart and bell quick views
expected: The favorite and price alert remain saved and their quick views can still filter the catalogue.

name: Filter catalogue and enforce comparison limit
description: Verifies catalogue controls remain usable after the review-site polish.
steps: Choose a store and lower the maximum price
Add three products to comparison and try to add a fourth
expected: Filters narrow and restore the catalogue, comparison stays limited to three products, and a visible maximum-three message appears for the fourth item.
